sessionStart.prompt: This repository may carry its own procedure skills — run, capture, diagnose, estimate, prototype — each reachable by name on either host. Invoke the skill instead of guessing a command, a URL, or a layout: run builds and launches the application from the repository's recipe at .claude/skills/run-<name>/SKILL.md — Claude Code's own run skill follows it, Copilot reaches it through .github/skills/run — leaves it running, and reports its entry points; capture takes evidence a reviewer can open, one file per checkpoint and per failure, the form named honestly; diagnose finds the cause of an observed issue from logs, traces, and breakpoints without handing the person a debugger, and leaves nothing behind in the change; estimate sizes work in story points off 1/2/3/5/8/13/21 against the repository's own reference examples and names the reference each estimate was compared with; prototype answers one named design question with a throwaway standalone HTML file and returns the answer beside it — a state model with a state panel, free play, and walkthroughs in the domain's terms, or structurally different screen variants on the repository's demo template, in its design system and Storybook — or revises an existing demo with its screen ids kept; it is never merged, writes into no .devbook/ folder, and changes no source file. The goal in each wrapper is fixed; the procedure is the repository's — edit .agents/skills/<name>.md, or the run-<name> recipe for run, never the wrapper. A skill that is absent here was not adopted: do without it and say so, never invent the procedure.
